text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.title: Xaeros Minimap Fairplay Nation Overlay Settings
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Everything
Master toggle - turn off to hide all rendering while data still tracks in the background (useful for screenshare safety)
Show Nation Fills
Toggle nation territory color overlays on/off
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.n: Opacity of nation territory color fills (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque)
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Node Borders
Toggle resource node territory borders on/off
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.w: Override all node border colors to white
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.o: Line width of the diagonal marking captured (occupied-but-not-annexed) TERRITORIES (whole nodes), drawn in the occupier's nation color
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show War Stripes
Toggle the X-stripe marker on individual CHUNKS captured within the last 90 seconds, drawn in the capturing nation's color
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.w: Line width of the post-capture chunk war stripe
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Under-Attack Stripes
Toggle the diagonal marker on individual CHUNKS with a flag currently planted (an attack in progress), drawn in the attacker's nation color
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.u: Line width of the under-attack chunk stripe
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Node Labels
Toggle resource node text labels on/off
Show Town Labels
Toggle town name text labels on/off
Show Nation Labels
Toggle nation name labels (shown larger, at each nation's capital) on/off
Show Building Labels
Toggle building name text labels (ports, factories) on/off
Show Building Markers
Toggle building ring markers (ports, factories), colored by type, on/off
Show Train Station Labels
Toggle train station text labels (id, tier, banned flag) on/off
Show Train Routes
Toggle train route lines between connected stations on/off
Show Train Station Icons
Toggle the minecart icon marker at each train station on/off
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.t: Line width of train route lines
